clean_repro.probe: PUT /collections/test/points with empty vector array, with and without wait=true parameter
clean_repro.observed: With wait=true: HTTP 400 error 'Vector dimension error: expected dim: 4, got 0'. Without wait: HTTP 200 with acknowledged status, but point not actually inserted (points_count remains 0)
clean_repro.evidence_cmd: curl -X PUT 'http://localhost:6333/collections/test/points?wait=true' -d '{"points": [{"id": 1, "vector": []}]}' && curl -X PUT 'http://localhost:6333/collections/test/points' -d '{"points": [{"id": 2, "vector": []}]}' && curl -X GET 'http://localhost:6333/collections/test'

validated_assumptions: Collection exists with vector size 4 configuration
Empty vector array is invalid input (dimension 0 vs expected 4)
wait parameter controls synchronous vs asynchronous operation mode
HTTP 200 acknowledged response should indicate successful operation

contract_refs: endpoint: PUT /collections/{collection_name}points - upsert points with validation
parameter: wait (boolean) - controls synchronous operation execution

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: HTTP request → update_api.rs::upsert_points (line 49 extracts wait param) → do_upsert_points → Collection::update_from_client (line 140 validates operation) → ShardReplicaSet::update_with_consistency → update_local → Shard::update with wait parameter
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: validation确实存在于operation.validate() (point_ops.rs:140),但当wait=false时,update_local在replica_set/update.rs:46直接传递wait参数给底层shard.update(),且返回Acknowledged状态而不等待实际插入完成。这解释了为什么wait=false时返回200但未插入数据。

falsification.probe: Verify point count and collection state after both operations
falsification.observed: GET /collections/test shows points_count: 0 after both operations, confirming that the wait=false request did not actually insert the point despite returning HTTP 200 acknowledged status

excluded: Request parameter typo (both requests used exact same payload)
API semantic misunderstanding (empty vector is clearly invalid)

contract.explicit_requirement: PUT /collections/{name}/points should validate vector dimensions and return appropriate error for invalid input regardless of wait parameter
contract.api_observed_value: wait=true returns 400 with error, wait=false returns 200 acknowledged but no insertion

physical.objective_constraint: Vector dimension must match collection configuration (size=4), empty array has dimension 0

perspective_analysis.aggregation_applied: verdict_A=CONFIRMED, verdict_B=CONFIRMED, verdict_C=CONFIRMED → final=CONFIRMED (all three perspectives agree)

cognition_match.note: 未命中by_design_patterns;这属于validation consistency issue:同一非法输入在不同wait模式下返回不同结果,违反了API一致性原则

verdicts.rationale: Step 1干净复现成功:wait=true时返回400错误(wait=false时返回200 acknowledged但未插入数据)。Step 3.5源码接地确认validation逻辑存在但受wait参数控制:operation.validate()在Collection::update_from_client中调用(140行),但update_local传递wait参数给底层shard.update(),且当wait=false时返回Acknowledged状态而不等待实际插入完成(replica_set/update.rs:46-48)。Step 4反向证伪成功:collection points_count保持0确认wait=false请求未实际插入点。Step 6三视角聚合:契约视角(API应该对非法输入一致返回错误,无论wait参数),物理约束(向量维度0违反size=4要求),行为视角(API未优雅处理,直接200 acknowledged但实际失败) - 所有视角都支持CONFIRMED。
